entries: `/vstack-clean` and the vstack-flow Tern plugin no longer fail with `ENOENT ... posix_spawn` after a Tern update. A pane started before the update keeps a `TERN_EXE` that names a removed binary, such as the old `Tern Daemon.app` helper. They now run `tern` from PATH when `TERN_EXE` names a file that does not exist.
